description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerOptions class, which contains configurable options for managing stateless worker grains in Orleans, including parameters like idle worker removal, inspection period, and minimum idle cycles before removal.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates configuration options for stateless worker grains in Orleans.

methods.name: RemoveIdleWorkers
methods.description: Boolean property that indicates whether idle workers should be proactively deactivated by the runtime.

methods.name: IdleWorkersInspectionPeriod
methods.description: TimeSpan indicating how often the system inspects for idle workers.

methods.name: MinIdleCyclesBeforeRemoval
methods.description: Integer specifying the number of consecutive idle cycles a worker must exhibit before being considered for removal.
